description: Transcript (captions) of a public YouTube video from YouTube caption tracks: title, channel, length, available caption languages, and the chosen track as timed segments (start and duration in seconds, text) plus the joined full text. Prefers human captions over auto-generated ones. Videos without captions return an empty segment list; private or removed videos return 404. YouTube bot-checks some requests: those return 503 (not charged), retry. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_youtube_channel_email when you need YouTube channel About page from YouTube's public page data; social_youtube_comments when you need First page of top comments on one YouTube video: author. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

lang.description: Preferred caption language code, e.g. en, de, es (default en; falls back to the first track)

video.description: YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed) or the 11-character video ID

name: social_youtube_transcript
title: Transcript of a public YouTube video from YouTube caption
